verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a marketing-page claim that users can describe an audience, journey or growth goal and mParticle will suggest the logic and help turn intent into activation. That is a natural-language, assistant-like capability inside the product, but it reads as suggestion rather than delegated task execution, and it has no product documentation behind it. missing for 10: a named or documented in-product AI assistant, evidence that it executes delegated tasks rather than only suggesting logic, a list of the tasks it can take on, product docs beyond the marketing page, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Describe the audience, journey, or growth goal. mParticle understands the customer data behind it, suggests the logic to use, and helps turn intent into revenue-driving activation.
